design.why_failed: #5936 (model-aware context ceiling) and #4582 (staging review hardening) matched only on the devdocs/modules/lean.md path; they address per-lane context cost and release review, not batch-level efficiency detection, so they did not fail on this symptom and there is nothing to delete or replace. The real prior art is failure/stall-only health (#5167, #5938, #5806) and the manual GitHub-based bin/stats/efficiency.mjs (#4402); this change extends them with a live ledger and SLOs, reusing the #5806 persisted-signature dedupe pattern.

outcome.metric: SLO breaches and filed engine-gap issues from fixture replays of the two batches vs a healthy fixture
outcome.target: concurrency, repeat, attempts and intervention SLOs breach; exactly 1 issue per signature; 0 for the healthy fixture; <=1 update per signature per 6 h

requirements.quote: Efficiency ledger (`bin/lean/efficiency.mjs`): computed every schedd pass from `log.jsonl` + live pool/sched state, written to `<batch>/efficiency.json` and the `status` line

achieved/ceiling concurrency (time-weighted, 15 min window), idle-slot lane-minutes by cause (capacity code, lease-held, base.red, hold, breaker, auth pause, no-ready), attempts per merged issue, engine comments per issue, repeated identical failure signatures, operator interventions per day (FORGE:DECISION, `--set-*`, requeue, hold, schedd restart), phase p50/p90 vs a 14-day baseline, merged/hour, wasted lane-hours (runs not ending merged, where the issue did or did not later merge), $ per merge.

**SLOs with defaults** (forge.yaml `orchestrate.slo.*`): achieved/ceiling >= 0.6 for 30 min while ready>0; any signature repeated >= 3; attempts per merged issue <= 2 (rolling 24 h); comments per issue <= 20; operator interventions <= 6/day; any phase p90 > 1.5x baseline; capacity refusals > 20/h; idle-slot minutes per cause > 20% of slot time.

on breach, `forgedock` files (or updates one rolling) `engine-gap` issue in the ForgeDock repo with the evidence table, window, batch id, offending issues and the suggested cause, deduplicated by signature `slo:<code>:<repo>`; re-breach appends a comment with a counter, resolution closes it after 24 h green.
One short line in `forgedock status` ("efficiency: 3/12 lanes (25%) - limiter sandbox.capacity pool.host_load; 2 SLO breaches -> FD#NNNN").

run `fd-introspect` automatically at batch end and daily (schedd hook or systemd timer), with `--file-issues` so findings are filed (deduped against open issues and prior reports), not only printed; its report path is linked from the rolling issue.
fix/guard `execution-budget.json` duplicate sandbox entries; a unit test that sums to the sandbox-minutes in `log.jsonl` within 5%.
Fixture replays of 11-20..11-24 for both batches breach concurrency, repeats, attempts and interventions SLOs and produce exactly one deduped issue per signature; a healthy fixture produces none.
`status` shows the efficiency line; `efficiency.json` schema documented in devdocs/modules/lean.md.
Timer/hook installed by `forgedock doctor`/install; introspect output filed with dedupe test.
Alert noise: no more than 1 issue update per signature per 6 h.
files (or updates one rolling) `engine-gap` issue in the ForgeDock repo
